name: Battlezone
detail: This is the Auxiliary PCB 035678-01; Battlezone's game PCB is 035742. They are different boards with separate designator grids, connected by J19 -- the game PCB sends EDB0-7, EAB0-6, ER/WB, EI/O, EPHI2 and the E6MHZ/E12KHZ/E3MHZ clocks across. A designator like C1 means a different chip on each.

name: Red Baron
detail: Red Baron's Math Box is the same circuit with the same microcode PROMs (036175-036180), so the signatures here apply to it. It is not the same PCB: Red Baron's sheet calls its board 036305-01 and places the parts differently -- PROMs at E1-L1 instead of M1-F1, the multiply latch at D4 instead of C5. Check positions against Red Baron's own sheet.

name: Tempest Auxiliary PCB
detail: Tempest's Auxiliary PCB 037585-01 carries this Math Box at different positions: B4, B1, C1, E1/D1, PROMs M1-F1 and slices K2, F2, H/J2, D/E2 here are Tempest's A2, A1, B1, D1/C1, PROMs L1-E1 and slices E2, J2, F/H2, K/L2. Traced independently from each board's own drawing, all 79 nets between those parts agree pin for pin and all 65 signatures printed on both sheets agree.
